desc: P1 is an SA/DA model featuring a shorter barrel and slide. This creates a compact version of the K100 while maintaining the original firing capacity and grip comfort. It is especially valued for concealed carry and personal defense. Despite the shortened barrel, its accuracy and shooting performance remain comparable to full-sized models. The standard sights include a side-adjustable steel rear sight and a plastic front sight, with a fiber-optic front sight available upon customer request.
